checks.claim: The real orchestrator service is healthy.
A synthetic overnight executive run produces a briefing.
Only trusted low-risk FAQ/community/product-interest signals are auto-handled.
An untrusted external-message signal is drafted without claiming a send.
Billing work is paused behind explicit owner approval.
Deployment work is paused behind explicit owner approval.
Signup/conversion evidence is included in the briefing.
A code/product update requires repeated passing verification evidence before being marked verified.
The overnight report creates a persisted voice-session handoff.
The requested future briefing time is retained.
Every input signal produces an explicit disposition and summary.
Approval-gated actions are visible in the existing pending-approval surface.
The generated briefing is queryable from the executive briefing history.
Evidence remains synthetic-source hosted runtime proof, not proof of real email, phone, DM, billing, or deployment connector execution.
